We look forward to you joining us on the next step in your educational journey.
Fall 2027 Application is live!
Missouri S&T is still accepting applications for the 2026–2027 academic year.
Returning to complete your application:
Please Note: If you are returning to complete an application that you have already started filling out, please click on the application, and then click 'Open Application' on the pop-up box to accept the default campus selection (which will match what you selected at time of creation). If you click to select the other option, your application type will be changed automatically.
For questions regarding application options, please contact the Office of Admission.
Returning users:
Log in to continue an application.
First-time users:
Create an account to start a new application.
